# Generated photographic assets

All assets were generated with the built-in `image_gen.imagegen` tool on 2026-10-16. Original generated PNG files were copied into this project without image editing.

## hero-coast.png — final prompt

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: premium wedding photography website hero photograph.
Primary request: cinematic, luxurious wedding editorial photograph of an adult East Asian bride and groom standing together on rugged coastal rocks beside an Italian-style coastline.
Subject: an elegant adult East Asian bride wearing a flowing white wedding gown with a soft airy train, and an adult East Asian groom wearing a beautifully tailored black suit. Natural intimate body language, believable proportions and detailed real skin.
Scene/backdrop: expansive tranquil deep teal Mediterranean sea and textured warm coastal rocks; distant Italian-style coastal cliffs, understated and atmospheric.
Style/medium: high-end fine-art wedding photography, photorealistic, warm analog film color, restrained fashion editorial sophistication.
Composition/framing: horizontal 3:2 landscape image. The couple is in the middle-right of the frame, photographed full length with enough distant sea and rocks around them. Usable calm space toward the left, cinematic wide view with the couple clearly readable.
Lighting/mood: soft golden dusk backlight, delicate luminous gown fabric, gentle breeze, intimate and serene.
Constraints: one cohesive photograph, two adult subjects only, authentic skin texture, natural hands and faces. No text, no logo, no watermark, no typography, no frame, no collage.
```

## editorial-portrait.png — final prompt

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: luxury portrait studio website editorial photograph.
Primary request: a refined half-length fashion portrait of one adult East Asian woman in a minimal black evening dress.
Scene/backdrop: simple dark studio background, almost black with subtle warm charcoal depth.
Subject: an elegant adult East Asian woman in her late twenties, wearing a beautifully cut minimalist black dress, natural poise, understated styling and makeup. Refined, restrained expression.
Style/medium: premium artistic analog film portrait photography, high realism and genuine skin detail, subtle film grain.
Composition/framing: vertical 2:3 portrait, half-length from head to waist, relaxed elegant pose, subject clearly visible, fashion editorial composition.
Lighting/mood: warm golden directional side light sculpting the face and shoulders against the dark backdrop, soft transitions, intimate cinematic mood.
Materials/textures: visible natural pores and subtle skin variation, fine fabric detail, rich controlled blacks.
Constraints: one adult woman only. One cohesive photograph. Anatomically natural face and hands. No text, no logo, no watermark, no frame, no collage. Avoid excessive retouching and plastic skin.
```
